exploreItems.title: Claim
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A territorial claim states an asserted authority.

exploreItems.title: Practice
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Effective control needs evidence of authority actually carried out.

exploreItems.title: Limit
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: One map or expedition does not establish lasting control of every community.

exploreItems.title: Named leadership
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The NHCP marker dates Kudarats rule to 1619-1671.

exploreItems.title: Several actions
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The account includes alliance, opposition and a peace agreement in 1645.

exploreItems.title: Source limit
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A later marker does not record every conversation or local response.

exploreItems.title: Material evidence
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Archaeology studies objects and other remains in their recorded context.

exploreItems.title: Change matters
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A terrace landscape need not have been identical throughout its history.

exploreItems.title: Date carefully
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A deposit or one site does not establish one date for every terrace.

exploreItems.title: Interactions
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Trade and negotiation are forms of contact, not automatic proof of complete conquest.

exploreItems.title: Place matters
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A post in one place does not establish the same authority everywhere around it.

exploreItems.title: Source limit
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Treaty wording and an authors account need dated evidence of actual practice.

exploreItems.title: Locate carefully
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The Cordillera is a region; a regional name is not one communitys full identity.

exploreItems.title: Named example
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Ifugao is one particular group and setting, not every Cordillera community.

exploreItems.title: Evidence scope
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A modern museum overview does not establish every colonial institution or boundary.

exploreItems.title: Connections
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Sulu had trading relationships with neighboring polities and wider markets.

exploreItems.title: Work and conditions
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Exchange depended on work, which could include unequal and forced conditions.

exploreItems.title: No stereotype
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Specific harmful actions do not define every person of a religion or community.

exploreItems.title: Political community
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A polity concerns organized authority; a sultanate is headed by a sultan.

exploreItems.title: Distinct examples
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Sulu and Maguindanao were separate polities with connections.

exploreItems.title: Variation
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: One religion or regional label does not describe every community or person.

exploreItems.title: Communication
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Diplomacy involves messages and negotiation, not only the absence of conflict.

exploreItems.title: Named agreement
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: The NHCP marker identifies a Kudarat peace agreement in 1645.

exploreItems.title: Follow-up
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: An agreement needs later evidence to establish implementation and outcomes.

exploreItems.title: Work together
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Researchers and descendant communities can contribute to interpreting the past.

exploreItems.title: Different evidence
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A site record, a collection entry and a community account support different questions.

exploreItems.title: Respect and limits
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Living communities are not frozen objects, and no source speaks for every person.

exploreItems.title: Local affairs
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Autonomy concerns maintaining decisions about community affairs.

exploreItems.title: Named case
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Ifugao research links resistance with local strategies and organization.

exploreItems.title: Scope
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Autonomy is not equal power for everyone or the absence of rules and contacts.

exploreItems.title: Opposition
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Resistance concerns opposing a demand or imposed authority.

exploreItems.title: Different forms
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Not every form of resistance is armed fighting.

exploreItems.title: Evidence and harm
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Identify the recorded action and its context without rewarding or erasing harm.

exploreItems.title: Terms
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: An agreement records commitments or claims.

exploreItems.title: Versions
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Check which text, translation and perspective a source presents.

exploreItems.title: Practice
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Implementation and local effects need evidence beyond signing.

exploreItems.title: Aim and outcome
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: What people sought and what followed are different claims.

exploreItems.title: Follow the evidence
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Later records can help investigate implementation and effects.

exploreItems.title: Limits
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: One account does not establish every persons result or a permanent outcome.

exploreItems.title: Diversity
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: Sama, Tausug and other communities cannot be reduced to one identical experience.

exploreItems.title: Perspective
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A source has a maker, purpose and date.

exploreItems.title: Scope
exploreItems.hint: Look for an idea and a limit.
exploreItems.discovery: A ruler, institution or category does not automatically speak for every person.

fields.title: Autonomy and Community Response Evidence Challenge
fields.description: Complete 10 activities: six clue-and-conclusion decisions and four matching tasks. Both parts of an evidence decision count together as one activity. Get at least 7 activities correct. All supplied lesson clues are available without saving them in your journal.
